in_sanskrit.name: शरवणी
in_sanskrit.meaning: शरणागति (शरणम् आगती) - One who has taken refuge in Lord Shiva
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who has taken refuge in Lord Shiva, seeking His protection and blessings. शरण (Sharaṇa) means refuge, protection, shelter. आगती (Aagatī) is a feminine form of आगत (Aagat), meaning one who has come or arrived.

in_tamil.name: சரவணி
in_tamil.meaning: சரணம் ஆகதி - One who has taken refuge
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who has taken refuge and seeks protection and blessings. சரணம் (Sarana) means refuge, protection, shelter. ஆகதி (Aagathi) is a feminine form of ஆகது (Aagathu), meaning one who has come or arrived.

in_telugu.name: శరవాణి
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who has taken refuge and seeks protection and blessings. శరణ (Sarana) means refuge, protection, shelter. ఆగతి (Aagathi) is a feminine form of ఆగత (Aagatha), meaning one who has come or arrived.

in_marathi.name: Sharavani
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharavani हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'shara', meaning 'peace' and 'vani', meaning 'voice'. This name signifies a peaceful voice, or a calm and gentle nature.

in_bengali.name: Sharavani
in_bengali.long_meaning: Sharavani একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'shara', meaning 'peace' and 'vani', meaning 'voice'. This name signifies a peaceful voice, or a calm and gentle nature.

vedic_reference.note: This name is derived from the Sanskrit term शरणागति (sharaṇāgati), which is used in Hindu scriptures to refer to the devotees who have taken refuge in Lord Shiva. It is also a name of the goddess Saraswati, who is the goddess of knowledge, learning, and wisdom.
